versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80020 In case of "event" semantic an IOC_E_LOST_DATA Overlayed Error shall be returned by the IocReceive function if the IOC communication service refused an IocSend request from sender due to an internal buffer overflow. There is no error in the data returned in parameter.

In case of "event" semantic an IOC_E_LOST_DATA Overlayed Er- ror shall be returned by the IocReceive function if the IOC communication service refused an IocSend request from sender due to an internal buffer overflow. There is no error in the data returned in parameter.
